title: Quant Pilot Dependency Nudge Rollup (Nov 2029)
summary: Lightweight one-page tracker to surface outstanding infra/model/test dependencies blocking the int8 quantization pilot. Purpose is to nudge owners, show short ETA, and capture quick mitigation options for next 48–72h. Not comprehensive — use for cross-team updates during the ad-hoc standups.

quick_pivots: If int8-kernel-build CI remains blocked: fallback to canary build with previous matmul and widened batch-window for canaries.
If KV-cache flake >1%: enable aggressive compaction in canary only and reroute 10% traffic to canary variant.

notes_to_self: Use this sheet only for 48–72h nudges. Move persistent items into the team's tracker (REDW backlog) after resolution. Ping on #quant-pilot daily at 09:30 PST for quick updates.
